source: NVD CVE API / NIST public vulnerability records

cves.title: Apache Log4j2 remote code execution (Log4Shell)
cves.description: JNDI features in Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1 do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI endpoints, allowing remote code execution when message lookups are enabled.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.17.1 or later (2.12.4 for Java 7, 2.3.2 for Java 6). Remove JNDI lookups and review logs for exploitation indicators.

cves.title: Spring Framework data binding remote code execution (Spring4Shell)
cves.description: Spring MVC/WebFlux applications running on JDK 9+ can be vulnerable to data-binding manipulation that writes a malicious web shell when deployed as a WAR on Tomcat.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18+ or 5.2.20+, or apply the vendor workaround. Upgrade to a supported Spring Boot release.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server path traversal and remote code execution
cves.description: A flaw in path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows path traversal; when files outside the document root are served by CGI, it can lead to remote code execution. Version 2.4.50 did not fully address the issue.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later. Ensure require all denied is configured for files outside the document root.

cves.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway information disclosure (Citrix Bleed)
cves.description: Sensitive information disclosure in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway allows session token leakage when configured as a gateway or AAA virtual server. The flaw was exploited in the wild.
cves.remediation: Apply Citrix security updates and invalidate all active NetScaler sessions. Review authentication logs for anomalous session reuse.

cves.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect command injection
cves.description: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allows an unauthenticated network attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges under specific configurations.
cves.remediation: Apply the vendor hotfix immediately, disable GlobalProtect if patching is delayed, and investigate for indicators of compromise.

cves.title: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN out-of-bounds write
cves.description: An out-of-bounds write in FortiOS SSL VPN may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.
cves.remediation: Upgrade FortiOS to a fixed release. Disable SSL VPN if it cannot be patched immediately and monitor for exploitation.

cves.title: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat information disclosure (Heartbleed)
cves.description: The TLS/DTLS heartbeat implementation in OpenSSL 1.0.1 before 1.0.1g allows remote attackers to read process memory, potentially exposing private keys, credentials and session data.
cves.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or later, reissue certificates, rotate secrets and invalidate sessions that may have been exposed.

cves.title: Microsoft SMBv1 remote code execution (EternalBlue)
cves.description: The SMBv1 server in affected Microsoft Windows releases mishandles specially crafted packets, allowing remote code execution. The vulnerability was used by WannaCry and other malware.
cves.remediation: Apply MS17-010 updates, disable SMBv1, block SMB at network boundaries, and require SMB signing.

cves.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset denial-of-service
cves.description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial-of-service through rapid stream creation and reset. Multiple HTTP/2 server implementations are affected.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor updates, enforce HTTP/2 stream and request limits, and use upstream DDoS protections.

cves.title: OpenSSH signal handler race condition (regreSSHion)
cves.description: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH's server (sshd) may allow unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems under certain conditions.
cves.remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8p1 or apply the distribution backport. Restrict SSH exposure and monitor authentication failures.

cves.title: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL injection
cves.description: A SQL injection vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access the database and execute code. It was exploited in a large-scale data theft campaign.
cves.remediation: Apply the vendor patch, audit for web shells and unauthorized accounts, and rotate exposed credentials.

cves.title: Microsoft Netlogon elevation of privilege (Zerologon)
cves.description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Netlogon allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to a domain controller to establish a vulnerable connection and take over the domain.
cves.remediation: Apply the August 2020 and subsequent Windows updates, enable enforcement mode after remediation, and monitor Netlogon events.

cves.title: F5 BIG-IP iControl REST authentication bypass
cves.description: Undisclosed requests to the iControl REST interface may bypass authentication and allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary system commands.
cves.remediation: Upgrade BIG-IP to a fixed version, restrict access to the management interface, and investigate for unauthorized changes.
